business_problem: Noodoe needed a more reliable global platform after its early Firebase and Elasticsearch stack crashed regularly and could not keep up with growing EV-charging data.
solution_summary: Noodoe replaced an early Firebase, Firestore, and Elasticsearch combination with MongoDB Atlas on AWS to stabilize the software platform behind its EV charging-station management business. Atlas became the core data store for globally distributed charging services that handle load balancing, smart scheduling, automated demand response, eRoaming, fleet management, subscriptions, and energy-storage integrations. The team chose Atlas because it offered a managed web interface, operational metrics, indexing support, and the same services in every region as Noodoe expanded from Taiwan into the United States, Canada, Australia, and beyond. That shift gave the company a more reliable foundation for global growth and reduced the operational burden on a small engineering team.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores charging-station, application, and operational data for Noodoe's global management platform.

data_flow: Charging-station, application, and operational data is stored in MongoDB Atlas on AWS and consumed by load-balancing, scheduling, eRoaming, and fleet-management services across regions.
business_outcome: Noodoe stabilized its EV charging platform, supported international expansion, and built a reliable foundation for charging operations across many regions.
